turns.text: Hello, my print still hasn't arrived and I need help with the delivery.

Hello, I'm sorry your print has not arrived yet. I can help with that. To find your order, please send me the order number (it starts with SC- followed by four digits) and the email address the order was placed with.
I'm filing a complaint with the consumer authority ANPC today. I'll also contact my bank for a chargeback and leave a public review.
I'm sorry this has been so frustrating. I have passed your case to a colleague, who will take over the conversation shortly and help with your delivery.
